text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to replace the existing parking prohibition in effect with a stopping prohibition at all times on the south side of Charles Street West, east of Bay Street, in order to enhance the traffic flow and to provide more space for vehicles to make turns.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Charles Street West, between Bay Street and a point 66.5 metres west of Yonge Street, to operate between a point 49 metres east of Bay Street and a point 66.5 metres west of Yonge Street. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Charles Street West, between Bay Street and a point 49 metres east.
